source.title: Partita No. 2 in D minor, BWV 1004 — V. Chaconne

method: Licensed symbolic score → LilyPond/MIDI → voice-aware performed event table; tuning estimated with librosa; Sync Toolbox 1.4.2 memory-restricted multiscale DTW at 50 frames/s, chroma + DLNCO. First/last attacks anchored by score-pitch energy rises in documented inspection windows; section anchors refined by DTW and checked against existing passage labels. Note-offs are warped notation, not measured key releases; final holds extend to a documented pitch-energy display boundary, not a measured key release. No aural review. See tools/align/REPORT.md.
repeats: The source’s two-quarter opening bar 1, then complete 3/4 bars 2–257 once. The D-major section begins at bar 133, D minor returns at bar 209, and the closing theme at bar 249 is written out; no repeats or arpeggio realisations are invented.
